name: acahti-saidc
description: Acahti git, PRs, pipelines, CI, and optional Work/Argos/Chat for your chosen instance.

interface.shortDescription: Acahti git, CI, and optional Work/Argos/Chat.
interface.longDescription: SAIDC workspace edition. MCP endpoint is preconfigured; each member supplies a personal ACAHTI_TOKEN through the environment. Benchyard onboarding uses Secrets and CLI. Use MCP first for identity, repositories and CI. Read whoami.modules for optional Work/Argos/Chat. Optional trusted hooks provide author reminders.
defaultPrompt: 连接我的 Acahti：检查 Benchyard 配置，缺失时引导我设置个人 Token，然后验证身份和待办
使用 Acahti MCP 查看当前仓库的 PR 和流水线状态；若 modules.argos 开启，说明 Argos 运行入口
提交代码前通过 Acahti MCP 核验 Author，设置当前仓库的 Git 身份并检查 CI
